682422.title: More actions reads Assign lead technician when a work order has no lead
682422.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)


Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682422 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two Approved work orders: {Work-order-1} with no lead technician, and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682422 Assign Wording, and {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} are S2-37401 and S2-37402.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
682422.custom_steps:
1. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned".
  2. Click "Assign lead technician".
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-2} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  5. Click "Reassign lead technician".
  6. Click "Cancel".
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the row for {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned".
  9. Click "Assign lead technician".
  10. Click "Cancel".
682422.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu offers "Assign lead technician". It does not say "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 2: a dialog titled "Assign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 3: the dialog closes and {Work-order-1} stays in "Unassigned".
  • Step 4: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 5: a dialog titled "Reassign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 6: the dialog closes and {Work-order-2} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 7: Tech View shows {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned" and {Work-order-2} in {Technician-A}'s group.
  • Step 8: the menu offers "Assign lead technician". It does not say "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 9: a dialog titled "Assign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 10: the dialog closes and {Work-order-1} stays in "Unassigned".

Developers also check this with unit tests (SV-11570): WorkOrderMoreActions.spec.ts ("the lead action's label") and ReassignLeadTechnicianDialog.spec.ts ("its title and confirm button").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician) and SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); ticket SV-11570

  • S3-R14: “Include the lead technician action in the card’s more-actions menu: “Assign lead technician” on a work order with no lead technician, “Reassign lead technician” on one that has a lead technician.”
  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the lead technician dialog, titled “Assign lead technician” or “Reassign lead technician” to match the menu item it was opened from (S3-R14).”
  • S4-R13: “Clicking a technician in the dialog assigns them at once; there is no confirm button, and the dialog’s only button is Cancel. When the shift-clearing prompt applies (S4-R28) it shows first, and the change is made from the prompt. Clicking the work order’s current lead closes the dialog with no change (S4-N4).”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

 

AUTOMATION: UNIT-TESTED - WorkOrderMoreActions.spec.ts › "the lead action's label"; ReassignLeadTechnicianDialog.spec.ts › "its title and confirm button". The confirm button went with the fast follow SV-11524 (passed QA on its QA branch sv11524, 26 Oct 2026).

682423.title: The lead technician dialog offers no Unassigned and assigns on one click
682423.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682423 Ana and {Technician-B} is ZZAUTOTEST C682423 Ben.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an Approved work order {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A}, with no shift booked for it on the Schedule. {Technician-B} is not the technician on any of its lines.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682423 One Click and {Work-order-1} is S2-37411.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
682423.custom_steps:
1. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  2. Click "Reassign lead technician".
  3. Read the dialog's list from the top.
  4. Read the dialog's buttons.
  5. Click {Technician-A} in the list.
  6. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1} again.
  7. Click "Reassign lead technician".
  8. Click {Technician-B} in the list.
682423.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 2: the "Reassign lead technician" dialog opens.
  • Step 3: a "Search technicians" box, then one list of technicians at {Location-A} with no grouping, each with an avatar and an "N open" count. {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are in it. There is no "Unassigned" row.
  • Step 4: the only button is "Cancel". There is no "Reassign" or other confirm button.
  • Step 5: the dialog closes and nothing changes: {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column and no message shows.
  • Step 6: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 7: the "Reassign lead technician" dialog opens.
  • Step 8: the dialog closes at once, with no other click, and {Work-order-1} moves to {Technician-B}'s column. The message "{Work-order-1} assigned to {Technician-B}" shows, with an "Undo" button.

Known problem (SV-11567, Open, fast follow; Undo is its own ticket, Chris Ward on SV-11524, 20 Oct 2026; seen on the QA branch sv11524 on 26 Oct 2026): the message has the right words but no "Undo" button, only a close (×), and it closes after about 2.6 seconds. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, Undo has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); tickets SV-11522 (Tech View) and SV-11524 (Board View)

  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and nothing else. Unassigned is not offered there: Unassigned is the place for work orders without a lead, not a technician, and removing the lead is the menu’s Unassign action (S11-R9) or a drag to Unassigned. It follows the design: a Search technicians box, each technician with their avatar and N open count, no grouping.”
  • S4-R13: “Clicking a technician in the dialog assigns them at once; there is no confirm button, and the dialog’s only button is Cancel. When the shift-clearing prompt applies (S4-R28) it shows first, and the change is made from the prompt. Clicking the work order’s current lead closes the dialog with no change (S4-N4).”
  • S4-N4: “Selecting the current lead again leaves all assignments unchanged and produces no reassignment toast.”
  • S4-R5: “After a successful lead change on Board View or Tech View, whether by drag, the dialog or Unassign, show the design’s toast (white, with the check icon) with an Undo button. It reads “{work order number} assigned to {technician name}”; “{work order number} lead technician set to {technician name}” when the new lead was already the technician on at least one of the work order’s lines; or “{work order number} moved to Unassigned” after removing the lead. Examples: “S1-357 assigned to Esther Howard”, “S1-702 lead technician set to Ralph Edwards”, “S1-352 moved to Unassigned”. This replaces the standard success toast for these messages only.”
  • PRD change log, 19 Oct 2026: “S4-R12, S4-R13, S4-R30: Unassigned is no longer offered in the dialog (Unassign stays in the menu, S11-R9); clicking a technician assigns at once, no Reassign button; clicking the current lead closes with no change. v66.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11567)

682425.title: Lead change messages stay while hovered and close after 5 or 2.6 seconds
682425.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682425 Ana and {Technician-B} is ZZAUTOTEST C682425 Ben.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two Approved work orders, {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}, both led by {Technician-A}. Neither has a shift booked on the Schedule, and no line of either has its own technician or any logged time.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682425 Toast Timing, and {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} are S2-37431 and S2-37432.
  • You have a stopwatch, for example on your phone.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
682425.custom_steps:
1. Drag the card for {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-B}'s column, let go and start the stopwatch.
  2. Keep the pointer away from the message and watch it.
  3. Drag the card for {Work-order-2} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-B}'s column and let go.
  4. Move the pointer onto the message and keep it there for 15 seconds.
  5. Move the pointer away from the message and watch it.
  6. Drag the card for {Work-order-1} from {Technician-B}'s column onto {Technician-A}'s column and let go.
  7. Click "Undo" on the message and start the stopwatch again.
  8. Keep the pointer away from the new message and watch it.
682425.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1} moves to {Technician-B}'s column and the message "{Work-order-1} assigned to {Technician-B}" shows, with "Undo".
  • Step 2: the message closes on its own about 5 seconds after you let go.
  • Step 3: the message "{Work-order-2} assigned to {Technician-B}" shows.
  • Step 4: the message stays open for the whole 15 seconds.
  • Step 5: the message closes on its own after you move away.
  • Step 6: {Work-order-1} moves to {Technician-A}'s column and the message "{Work-order-1} assigned to {Technician-A}" shows, with "Undo".
  • Step 7: the message closes at once, {Work-order-1} goes back to {Technician-B}'s column and a new message "Assignment undone" shows, with no "Undo" button.
  • Step 8: the "Assignment undone" message closes on its own about 2.6 seconds after it appeared.

Known problem (SV-11567, Open, fast follow; Undo is its own ticket, Chris Ward on SV-11524, 20 Oct 2026; seen on the QA branch sv11524 on 26 Oct 2026): the message has the right words but no "Undo" button, only a close (×), and it closes after about 2.6 seconds. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, Undo has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); tickets SV-11522 (Tech View) and SV-11524 (Board View)

  • S4-R16: “The lead-change toast closes on its own after 5 seconds (5,000 ms) while it carries the Undo button, and after 2.6 seconds (2,600 ms) without one, as in the design; it stays open while the pointer is over it, and closes when Undo is clicked. The “Assignment undone” toast (S4-R32) closes after 2.6 seconds. Other success toasts dismiss automatically, as today.”
  • S4-R5: “After a successful lead change on Board View or Tech View, whether by drag, the dialog or Unassign, show the design’s toast (white, with the check icon) with an Undo button. It reads “{work order number} assigned to {technician name}”; “{work order number} lead technician set to {technician name}” when the new lead was already the technician on at least one of the work order’s lines; or “{work order number} moved to Unassigned” after removing the lead. Examples: “S1-357 assigned to Esther Howard”, “S1-702 lead technician set to Ralph Edwards”, “S1-352 moved to Unassigned”. This replaces the standard success toast for these messages only.”
  • S4-R32: “Undo puts the work order back exactly as it was before the change: the previous lead technician (or Unassigned), its previous place in that technician’s order, and any shifts the change cleared (removed shifts come back as they were; a shift that was ended at the moment of the change gets its original end time back). Undo is itself a lead change: it records its own audit entry (S4-R9), follows the Invoiced or Paid rule (S4-N2), and shows no shift-clearing prompt. After Undo the design’s toast reads “Assignment undone”, with no Undo button on it. If Undo cannot be saved, nothing changes and the alert “Couldn’t undo the change. Please try again.” shows.”

Not yet checked against a build.
